shared_elements: rows of small repeated signs/marks arranged in horizontal registers
seated or crouching human figures (A) versus none in B
justification: Both surfaces present horizontal rows of small repeated marks across a flat wall-like field, and both involve bovine/horned motifs (A's carved signs and figures; B's actual mounted skull and horn cores), but this is a loose, generic correspondence. A is a dense, fully carved sign-script in ruled registers with two facing seated human figures at the base, while B has no human figures, no script, and its principal element is a three-dimensional horned skull mounted on plaster with only sparse painted or applied marks nearby.
